interaction.user_prompt: Linear-to-GitHub issue migration for OSS-scoped backlog
interaction.model_cot: Migrated 8 open Linear issues to GitHub (#31-#38) after reviewing each against current main; excluded all Platform-project issues as private/commercial. Substantive corrections made during migration: the sync-format spec issue was retargeted from designing v2 to documenting the already-shipped v5; the multi-root extension issue's original defect no longer exists (single-folder binding is now deliberate) so it was reframed as multiple per-repo bindings preserving the one-binding invariant; the plugin push/pull controls issue was rescoped inside the consent model (TTY-gated push, new hook-uninstall capability needed); the conversation-ids issue was slimmed to two verified residual placeholders (LSP turn/end default-session, MCP agent-session-default fallback). Two issues not migrated: the worktree hooks bug is fixed by merged PRs 29/30 (public record GitHub #27), and the CI-coverage issue is implemented in test.yml with only a branch-protection toggle remaining. All migrated bodies kept self-contained with no private links per CONTRIBUTING; Linear originals annotated with their GitHub twins.
